ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: International Companies Act (Cap. 222); Companies (Beneficial Ownership) Regulations 2017; Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act No. 13 of 2023; Financial Transactions Reporting Act (Cap. 276); Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) Rule Authorisation VFSC/AMLCFT/2023/01

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified copy of passport of each director, shareholder, and beneficial owner
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary Public in the country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (if country is party to the Hague Convention) OR Consular Legalization at a Vanuatu High Commission, Embassy, or Honorary Consulate

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified copy of proof of residential address (utility bill or bank statement, dated within 3 months)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Issuing utility company or licensed bank; certificate of notarization by local notary

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank reference letter from a licensed financial institution attesting to the applicant's business integrity
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Corporate or private bank of the applicant
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Apostille OR Consular Legalization; additionally must be directly e-mailed by the issuing bank to the registered agent

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Curriculum vitae / professional profile of each director and beneficial owner
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Applicant / author of the CV; must be notarized and authenticated pursuant to the same path

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Original or certified copy of certificate of incorporation for any corporate shareholder (if applicable)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Company registry of the corporate shareholder's jurisdiction

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory enhanced due diligence screening of all directors, shareholders, beneficial owners, and signatories against the VFSC AML/CFT Sanctions List, United Nations Security Council Consolidated List, OFAC SDN List, EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions Database, United Kingdom HMT sanctions list, and Australian DFAT consolidated list; PEPs are screened at, above, and below the 25% ownership threshold; status is reviewed against at least 10 years of public records; identification and verification of funds source is required for PEP-associated relationships; ongoing transaction monitoring is mandatory under FTRA reporting obligations.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) eRegistry — Online Name Reservation and Verification System (https://www.vfsc.vu)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Official name must be in Latin script; English or French permitted. Names may use words in Bislama if descriptive, but legal identifiers must be in English or French. The corporate suffix 'Limited' or 'Ltd' must appear exactly as set out in the International Companies Act. No translation or transliteration is required for the registered Latin-script name; however, a Bislama or French trading name can be registered separately.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: If name reservation is refused, the applicant or a licensed VFSC agent may file a written notice of appeal with the VFSC Companies Registry within 14 days of the refusal notice. The appeal must address each reason stated in the rejection, include a legal memorandum of compliance with the International Companies Act, and pay the administrative appeal fee of USD 130. VFSC Registrar must issue a decision within 21 working days. A second request for a new name reservation can be submitted simultaneously; if the appeal succeeds, the originally rejected name is granted with a fresh 30-day reservation period. If judicial review is required, a petition may be filed with the Supreme Court of Vanuatu under the Judicial Review Act (Cap. 38) within 45 days of final VFSC decision.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Not permissible as primary registered office. An International Company must maintain a physical registered office in Vanuatu that is publicly accessible during business hours, per Section 63 of the International Companies Act. A licensed registered agent must hold the registered office. A virtual office may serve only as a supplementary administrative address for correspondence but cannot replace the registered office requirement for this industry. Physical presence (lease or sublease) of the registered agent in Port Vila or Luganville is mandatory.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: 60% probability of unannounced physical on-site inspection within the first 12 months of operation, given the Medium_Risk_Enhanced AML classification for recycled scrap metal trading; VFSC and the Vanuatu Financial Intelligence Unit (FIU) conduct random compliance audits, with higher scrutiny on cross-border physical-commodity consignment businesses. Post-formation, an initial registered office inspection is performed via the registered agent in not less than 80% of newly incorporated International Companies in this industry.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Companies Act 1993 (Vanuatu), as amended; sections 5, 8, 9, 12, 14 and 26 (incorporation, registered office, directors, and registered agent)
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) – Registration and Licensing Division, International Companies Registry
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Memorandum and Articles of Association (M&A) submitted via Form 1 – Application for Incorporation as an International Company
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital; the Company shall maintain a registered share capital in its M&A, and any share premium or subscribed funds may be held in a VFSC-licensed bank account pending completion of beneficial ownership verification.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED that the Company be incorporated under the International Companies Act 1993 of Vanuatu, and that the subscribers' shares be allotted and issued to the founding shareholder in accordance with Clause 5 of the Articles. FURTHER RESOLVED that the registered office at the address of the licensed registered agent in Port Vila be adopted as the Company's statutory registered office. FURTHER RESOLVED that [Name], [Name], and [Name] be appointed as first directors, each to hold office until removed by ordinary resolution. FURTHER RESOLVED that [Name] be appointed as Company Secretary. FURTHER RESOLVED that the directors be authorized to open bank accounts, appoint a VFSC-licensed registered agent, and execute all documents necessary to obtain industrial and environmental licenses for non-ferrous scrap copper trading.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Engage VFSC-Licensed Registered Agent and Reserve Company Name
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) via licensed registered agent (online portal: efiling.vfsc.vu)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Instruct the registered agent to perform a name availability search, submit a name reservation request, and confirm the proposed name does not resemble an existing International Company, Protected Cell Company, or foreign entity registered in Vanuatu. Obtain the name reservation certificate and preparer checklist.
required_dossiers: Identification documents of beneficial owner and directors
Consent to act as registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is refused, submit an appeal or alternative name application within 5 business days; amend the M&A accordingly.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Draft and Execute Memorandum and Articles of Association
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notary Public in Vanuatu or foreign notary apostilled for use in Vanuatu; VFSC in final review
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the M&A containing the company name, registered office clause, share capital clause, director provisions, and intended business object of buying, selling, storage, and consignment of non-ferrous scrap including recycled copper wire. Have subscribers sign before a notary; arrange notarial authentication of the signatures.
required_dossiers: Draft Memorandum and Articles of Association
Identity and address verification for each subscriber
Notarized resolution of provisional directors (if any)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If VFSC queries the objects clause or share capital provisions, file an amended M&A via the registered agent within 7 days and pay the nominal amendment fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: File Incorporation Application with VFSC and Pay Government Fee
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC International Companies Registry, PMB 9019, Port Vila, Vanuatu
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit Form 1 (Application for Incorporation), the notarized M&A, the name reservation certificate, consent of directors, consent of secretary, and registered agent certificate. Pay the official government filing fee of USD 300 plus agent disbursement charges. Receive Certificate of Incorporation upon approval.
required_dossiers: Notarized Memorandum and Articles of Association
Consents to act as director and secretary
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If VFSC issues a requisition, correct the deficiency within 14 days by filing a supplemental certificate and resubmitting through the registered agent; extension of 30 days is available by written request.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Obtain Company Seal, Share Certificates, and Register of Members
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Company's first directors under supervision of registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Prepare the common seal, issue share certificates to the founding shareholder, and open the register of members, register of directors, register of charges, and minutes book. Ensure all register entries are maintained at the registered agent's office in Port Vila.
required_dossiers: Registered office and registered agent address records
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If records are found defective, the directors may execute a rectification resolution and the registered agent shall file corrected registers; no VFSC filing is required unless a charge is registered.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: File First Board Resolution and Beneficial Ownership Declaration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC compliance department via registered agent portal
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Adopt the First Board Resolution setting share allotment, registered office, and officer appointments. File the resolution summary and beneficial ownership declaration (BO Register) with VFSC within 15 days of incorporation. Confirm statutory compliance under the International Companies Act and the Companies (Beneficial Ownership) Act 2022.
required_dossiers: Proof of identity and source of funds for beneficial owner
Consent forms of directors and secretary
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If VFSC requests additional evidence of source of funds, provide bank references and notarized affidavits; failure to remedy within 30 days may lead to administrative penalty or strike-off.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Vanuatu Ministry of Trade, Tourism, Industry and Cooperatives – Department of Industry; coordinated through VFSC for international company foreign investment registration
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Industrial / Commercial Operating Permit for Non-Ferrous Scrap Metal Trading and Consignment Activities

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Vanuatu Department of Environmental Protection and Conservation (DEPC), Ministry of Climate Change Adaptation, Meteorology, Geo-Hazards, Environment, Energy and Disaster Management
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Preliminary Environmental Assessment (PEA) / Registration; Full EIA not required unless storage capacity exceeds 500 tonnes or site is within 100 m of a watercourse or residential zone
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Compliance thresholds: no discharge of wastewater containing metallic residues exceeding 5 mg/L total suspended solids; VOC emissions from shredding or cleaning processes must remain below 20 mg/m³; copper dust and particulates controlled via wet suppression; waste handling must follow the Waste Management (Amendment) Act 2020 with manifest record keeping.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certification from the Vanuatu Fire and Rescue Services confirming adequate extinguishers and egress routes; structural load inspection certificate for any storage building confirming floor loading capacity for bulk copper scrap; workplace clearance certificate issued by the Department of Labour verifying occupational health and safety compliance under the Vanuatu Occupational Health and Safety Act 2018.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Department of Customs and Inland Revenue (DCIR), Ministry of Finance and Economic Management, Government of Vanuatu; official portal: Vanuatu Government e-Government Portal (www.gov.vu)
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Foreign entities are not required to obtain a statutory tax identification number (TIN) for income tax purposes because Vanuatu does not impose income tax. International Companies are statutorily exempt from all Vanuatu taxes under the International Companies Act. For customs purposes, an entity intending to export goods must apply for a Customs Client Code through ASYCUDA World by submitting the certificate of incorporation, registered agent certificate, board resolution, and valid identification of the company officers.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: None. Vanuatu has no income tax and International Companies are exempt from all domestic taxes on offshore business activities. No check-the-box or hybrid mismatch election is available or necessary. An International Company may elect to redomicile or convert to a domestic company under the Companies Act, but that is a commercial law election with no direct tax consequences.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: No general VAT or GST system in force; only specific customs and excise duties may apply to physical imports
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Not applicable — no VAT/GST registration threshold exists
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No e-invoicing or real-time fiscal clearance regime. Customs export declarations must be filed electronically through the ASYCUDA World system; no digital stamping requirement applies.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Not applicable: Vanuatu does not levy VAT or GST, and therefore has no zero-rating concept. Exports of goods, including recycled scrap copper wire, are generally not subject to any Vanuatu turnover tax or export duty, provided the shipment is properly declared through customs and physically departs Vanuatu.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Bill of Lading or Airway Bill
Scrap Metal Export Permit (where required by Vanuatu Department of Environmental Protection)
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: No VAT/export zero-rating clawback mechanism exists due to the absence of VAT. However, false or fraudulent customs declarations are subject to substantial monetary penalties, seizure and forfeiture of goods, and potential imprisonment under the Vanuatu Customs Act. Violations of environmental and waste-export permit conditions may result in additional administrative fines and suspension or revocation of the export licence.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Reserve Bank of Vanuatu (RBV), the central monetary authority and exchange-control administrator acting under the Exchange Control Act [Cap 113] and the Reserve Bank of Vanuatu Act [Cap 125]; the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) registers and licenses the International Company, and the Vanuatu Financial Intelligence Unit (VFIU) receives suspicious-transaction reports for the scrap-copper commodity corridor.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Vanuatu maintains current-account convertibility consistent with IMF membership practice; the VUV is managed against a trade-weighted AUD/EUR/NZD/USD basket, and trade-based settlements for ISIC 4669 scrap-copper imports and exports flow through RBV-licensed authorized dealers without prior exchange-control approval when supported by the standard documentary set. Capital-account entries, including inbound equity subscriptions, inter-company loans, and non-trade outward remittances, require an RBV exchange-control application and settlement through an authorized dealer. Profit and dividend remittance from a tax-exempt International Company to non-resident shareholders is permitted after (i) RBV exchange-control filing, (ii) source-of-funds certification evidencing completed physical consignments of copper scrap, and (iii) confirmation from the authorized dealer that no Vanuatu income tax is attributable to the IC. Residual friction resides in the correspondent-banking layer rather than in statute: banks apply enhanced scrutiny to Pacific-linked metal flows.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: The Exchange Control Act [Cap 113] imposes a statutory repatriation duty: all proceeds from the IC's export of recycled copper scrap must be received in Vanuatu through an authorized dealer within 180 days of the bill-of-lading date. No fixed surrender ratio or forced conversion into VUV is applied; proceeds may be retained in USD or AUD in the IC's foreign-currency account if earmarked for the next consignment cycle, but cumulative conversions above VUV-equivalent 10 million per month must be reported to the RBV. The IC must retain the export permit, customs declaration, scale or weighbridge tally, and assay certificate for seven years; failure to repatriate or settle through an authorized dealer exposes directors to penalty under the Exchange Control Act and may trigger VFSC deregistration of the IC.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Account (multi-currency USD) and Capital Escrow Account
Operational Account (VUV/AUD) and Trade Finance Settlement Account

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility: LOW. No domestic EMI or digital-banking sandbox exists in Vanuatu, and RBV does not license pass-through money-service businesses for physical commodity settlement. Offshore EMIs (UK FCA e-money institutions, EU EMIs, Australian neobanks) are constrained by their own CDD policies from onboarding a Pacific IC whose principal activity is high-risk scrap-metal trading, and the correspondent-de-risking climate blocks EMI clearing into Port Vila. An EMI may be retained only as a secondary, low-value disbursement rail after the anchor bank account is live; it must never receive export proceeds, which must route through the RBV-authorized dealer to satisfy exchange-control repatriation.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical attendance is the default mandate: RBV AML/CFT Rules and the AML/CFT Act No. 14 of 2016 require an in-person KYC interview for any medium-risk-enhanced corporate trading in commodity scrap; at least one director or the appointed treasury signatory must appear in Port Vila before account activation. Remote or out-of-country opening is available only where the KYC pack is notarized and certified by the IC's VFSC-registered agent, two independent directors complete video attestation, and the bank's MLRO grants a formal derogation; in practice, appointment of a resident licensed agent plus one physical director visit raises onboarding success from roughly 30% to 85%. The IC must pre-position the VFSC Certificate of Incorporation and Certificate of Good Standing, the registered agent's beneficial-ownership register under the International Companies Act [Cap 222], board resolutions, and proof of the scrap-copper supply chain before the interview is scheduled.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Trade-based money-laundering flags: over/under-invoicing of copper scrap against LME reference prices, weight or grade mismatches, phantom shipments, or duplicate bills of lading.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Transaction dossier: LME or SMM settlement-price screenshots; independent inspection certificate (SGS, Bureau Veritas, or Intertek) attesting weight and copper content; sealed-container packing list; bill of lading from the origin port; out-turn weight tally at destination; Letter of Credit field 46A document conditions mapping each physical event to a payment tranche.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Beneficial-ownership opacity: bearer-share or nominee structures, undisclosed ultimate beneficial owners, or multi-layer offshore intermediaries.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: VFSC-registered agent's certified register of directors and beneficial owners under the International Companies Act [Cap 222]; statutory declaration identifying all natural-person UBOs; holding-structure chart; where bearer instruments exist, evidence of immobilization with a VFSC-licensed custodian.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Sanctions and jurisdiction risk: counterparty, vessel, or port flags; residual correspondent-bank concern over Vanuatu's past FATF increased-monitoring episode and the Pacific region's de-risking climate.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Live screening results from Refinitiv World-Check or Dow Jones covering all counterparties, UBOs, vessels, and ports; vessel AIS and geo-tracking summary; commodity chain-of-custody certificates; confirmation that no transaction touches OFAC, UN, or EU-listed persons or FATF-identified high-risk jurisdictions.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Round-trip or rapid-flight capital: equity injection followed by near-immediate outward disbursement to a related offshore scrap trader.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Board resolution authorizing treasury operations; 12-month cash-flow budget for consignment purchase and resale; master supply agreement and sales contract with incoterms; external accountant's statement confirming equity deployment against confirmed purchase orders.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Missing statutory license: the VFSC register flags 'requires_statutory_license: true' for the scrap-export trading business model.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Valid Vanuatu business or trading license; export license for recycled non-ferrous scrap from the Department of Environmental Protection and Conservation under the Waste Management Act No. 10 of 2014; customs export permit; documentation consistent with transboundary waste-movement controls applicable to origin and destination jurisdictions, including Basel Convention notifications where in force.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Preferred route: SWIFT MT103 from the parent or shareholder bank, credited to the IC's authorized-dealer account in Vanuatu or to its USD nostro in ANZ's regional clearing hub. The wire must carry the inward-remittance purpose description 'Capital contribution to exempt International Company' as mapped by the receiving authorized dealer, the underlying ISIC 4669 purchase-order reference in field 70, and a board-extract mandate to preempt an AML referral. Verification packet: VFSC certificate of good standing, signed subscription resolution, source-of-funds statement from the remitting director, and RBV acknowledgment where the injection exceeds VUV-equivalent 50 million; funds remain restricted to the registered capital schedule until the bank confirms clean sanctions and AML hits.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Settlement rails: (i) SWIFT MT103 telegraphic transfer for prepayments and open-account balances up to USD 250,000 per consignment, conditional on pre-screening of the supplier's bank details and presentation of pro forma invoice and inspection certificate; (ii) irrevocable at-sight Documentary Letter of Credit (SWIFT MT700) as the dominant rail, issued by the Vanuatu authorized dealer in favor of the copper-scrap supplier and payable against compliant presentation of commercial invoice, third-party weight and assay certificate, full set of clean bills of lading, insurance certificate, and destination customs release; the LC field 46A conditions must exactly mirror the commercial contract to avoid discrepancy fees and title disputes; (iii) SWIFT MT760 standby LC as performance or guarantee support. All USD outflows clear through the IC's USD nostro subject to OFAC filtering; VUV-denominated disbursements are limited to domestic incidentals.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Onshore deliverable FX forward contracts (tenor up to 12 months) with the RBV-licensed authorized dealer for USD/AUD/EUR/NZD-VUV flows, supported by documentary evidence of scrap-copper trade exposure.
FX swaps and rollover facilities with the same authorized dealer for working-capital rebalancing; speculative use is prohibited under RBV exchange-control policy.
Cross-currency swaps (VUV/USD or VUV/AUD) executed onshore and individually notified to RBV where notional exceeds USD 5 million, with the proceeds earmarked for physical trade settlement.
Offshore non-deliverable forward on VUV: not permissible, because the VUV is not internationally deliverable and RBV does not license banks to transact non-deliverable VUV derivatives.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Return under the International Companies Act (Cap 222) — confirmed registered office, registered agent, members, directors, and prescribed declarations
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC), Registrar of International Companies
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 30 days (1 calendar month) after each anniversary of incorporation; if the anniversary falls on a weekend or public holiday, acceptance occurs on the next business day
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-filing surcharge VUV 10,000 (≈USD 83) per commenced month; IC marked delinquent on the VFSC register, blocking Certificates of Good Standing, documentary-credit bank due diligence, and charge registrations; default for 2 consecutive years triggers administrative strike-off, with assets vesting in the Registrar and personal liability of directors/agents for debts contracted after strike-off

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Economic Substance Return — nil/non-resident declaration or full substance report for the relevant activity 'Distribution and Service Centre'
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC), Economic Substance Registrar
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 12 months after the end of the financial period; default financial period is 1 January–31 December, making the return due by 31 December of the following year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Fixed penalty VUV 500,000 (≈USD 4,150) plus VUV 50,000 (≈USD 415) per month of continuing default; material false declarations attract fines up to VUV 2,000,000 (≈USD 16,600); persistent non-filing enables VFSC strike-off and registered-agent disqualification

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Beneficial Ownership Confirmation and CDD Refresh under the Anti-Money Laundering and Countering the Financing of Terrorism Act 2017 — UBO schedule, source of funds, and registered-agent engagement confirmation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Licensed Vanuatu registered agent; records subject to inspection by VFSC and the Vanuatu Financial Intelligence Unit
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Aligned to the incorporation anniversary and due no later than the Annual Return due date; every share transfer, allotment, or redemption must be notified to the registered agent within 30 days of the transaction
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Non-compliance with CDD/UBO duties: corporate fine up to VUV 10,000,000 (≈USD 83,000) and/or 5 years' imprisonment for responsible officers; unrecorded share transfers are unenforceable against the company and its registered agent until registered

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Business Licence Renewal under the Business Licences Act 1998 — applicable only where the IC maintains a fixed place of business, warehouse, or employees in Vanuatu for scrap-copper consignment handling
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Vanuatu Investment Promotion Authority (VIPA) with the Port Vila or Luganville Municipal Council
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Calendar-year licence: renewal application filed 1 October–31 December for the following year; commercial activities must cease on 1 January if renewal is not completed
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Unlicenced operation: fine up to VUV 500,000 (≈USD 4,150), daily compounding penalty VUV 10,000 (≈USD 83), municipal closure order, and loss of the IC's no-local-business exemption for the period of unlicenced operation

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No compulsory statutory audit applies to a Vanuatu International Company under the International Companies Act (Cap 222); independent audit becomes mandatory when (i) shareholders holding at least 10% of voting rights require an audited balance sheet and profit-and-loss account; (ii) the IC is separately licensed under a VFSC regulatory statute, such as the International Banking Act 2002 or Insurance Act 2005; (iii) the registered agent's enhanced due diligence or a confirming bank financing the documentary-LC flow demands audited financial statements; or (iv) VFSC orders an audit to verify beneficial ownership or economic substance data
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: International Financial Reporting Standards (full IFRS or IFRS for SMEs) is the market-standard framework; Vanuatu imposes no income-tax-basis accounting on International Companies, but books and records supporting every consignment sale, LC drawdown, and intercompany transfer must be prepared on an accrual basis reconcilable to IFRS

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 0% — Vanuatu imposes no corporate income tax; International Companies (ICs) under the International Companies Act [Cap. 222] are statutorily exempt from all national income taxation.
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Full statutory exemption from corporate income tax, dividend withholding tax, interest and royalty withholding tax, capital gains tax, payroll tax, and stamp duty on offshore contracts. The only recurring charge is the annual VFSC government fee; VAT of 4% applies solely to local Vanuatu supplies and is zero-rated for the export of recycled scrap copper wire.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: VFSC Annual Return Form IC-AR (International Companies Act [Cap. 222]) filed via the VFSC Corporate Online e-Portal; no corporate income tax return exists in Vanuatu.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Filing is due within 30 days after each anniversary of incorporation; a corporate income tax return has no deadline because no such return is required.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Company legal name, Vanuatu IC registration number, date of incorporation, and registered office address in Port Vila.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Insert the exact IC corporate name with the 'IC' suffix; the registered office must be the licensed resident agent's address; do not substitute a local trading address.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Licensed Vanuatu resident agent and registered agent's service address.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident shareholders must maintain a licensed VFSC resident agent; confirm the agent agreement is current before filing.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Authorized and issued share capital, par value, share classes, and any share movements during the year.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Report in USD or Vatu as stated in the constitutive documents; bearer shares are prohibited; disclose new issuances and any transfer of existing shares.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Directors, secretary, and registered shareholder schedule.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A minimum of one natural-person director is permitted; any nationality may serve; attach current KYC passports and proof of residential address for every officer.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Beneficial ownership declaration and CRS/FATCA classification.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Disclose all ultimate controlling natural persons; non-resident ownership is expressly allowed, but undisclosed control invalidates the filing and triggers AML scrutiny.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late or incorrect filing: default fine of VT 25,000 plus a daily surcharge of VT 2,500 per day of continued default; persistent non-filing leads to suspension of good standing, resignation of the resident agent, and compulsory strike-off and dissolution by the Registrar.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% — Vanuatu does not levy any withholding tax on dividends, whether paid to residents or non-residents.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Not applicable — Vanuatu has no comprehensive double taxation agreement in force; no TRC submission or DTA relief protocol is required locally because no dividend withholding tax is deducted; the non-resident shareholder must instead report and pay tax in its own jurisdiction of residence.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: 0% statutory rate on both cross-border royalties and debt interest; no treaty rate applies due to the absence of a DTA network.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: No statutory Vanuatu threshold: Vanuatu has no mandatory Local File or Master File regime. Functional compliance benchmark: prepare OECD-aligned transfer pricing documentation once related-party cross-border scrap copper turnover exceeds USD 1,000,000, in order to withstand audits in the scrap-origin jurisdiction and the shareholder's residence jurisdiction.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: ESR applies through the International Companies (Economic Substance) (Amendment) Act 2019 and the annual VFSC Economic Substance Return. An IC claiming Vanuatu tax residence must demonstrate substantial activity, including procurement, LC financing, and shipping decisions, within Vanuatu. A pure offshore physical consignment business more prudently files the non-resident ESR exemption declaration stating tax residence in the shareholder's jurisdiction; failure to evidence substance heightens EU blacklist scrutiny, bank de-risking, and group-level CFC assessments.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Directing and managing the recycled scrap copper trading from an onshore jurisdiction such as Hong Kong or Singapore while booking the full profit margin inside the zero-tax Vanuatu IC and concealing the arrangement from the beneficial owner's residence tax authority.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Full corporate income tax recomputation of all IC profits in the residence jurisdiction at the applicable headline rate, plus evasion penalties of 100% to 300%, interest surcharges, and denial of any foreign-tax credit because the undisclosed income was never declared.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Personal liability of the controlling shareholder-director for civil restitution of diverted profits, cross-border travel bans pending criminal inquiry, and imprisonment of up to 10 years for fraudulent tax evasion.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Maintaining only a mailbox registered office in Port Vila with no procurement, negotiation, logistics, or payment-execution personnel; executing trade contracts through nominee agents instead of a board that genuinely exercises governance of the scrap-copper consignment business.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Refusal of the VFSC annual return, default penalties, and compulsory strike-off of the IC; in counterparty jurisdictions the entity is treated as a sham, and deductions, treaty-like benefits, and LC financing are denied on a look-through basis.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Breach of director duties under the IC Act; court-ordered personal contribution and disgorgement of profits, seizure of personal assets, and director disqualification for up to 15 years.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Inflated or fictitious invoicing of recycled copper wire, circular cargo movements using the same container transshipped repeatedly, commingling VAT-free scrap export proceeds with cash settlements, or using the IC to launder proceeds for associate scrap dealers.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Vanuatu AML/CTF Act No. 16 of 2016 (as amended): corporate fines up to VT 100 million, confiscation and forfeiture of the scrap consignments, freezing orders on bank accounts, and revocation of any VFSC license held by related service providers; foreign jurisdictions may impose parallel asset forfeiture and criminal fines.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors acting with willful blindness face imprisonment of up to 20 years, personal fines, travel bans, and civil restitution to defrauded LC issuing banks.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Misdeclaring the ultimate beneficial owner in the VFSC annual return, failing to maintain the statutory BO register, or omitting the ESR exemption return while concealed control rests with a politically exposed person.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Default fines and daily surcharges under the IC Act, deregistration, and referral to VFSC AML enforcement, which may revoke the resident agent's license and exchange information via CRS/FATCA channels.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Criminal liability for false certification, fines and imprisonment of up to 5 years, and a statutory bar from serving as a director of any Vanuatu company.
